"''Long live the Empire.|Moff Gideon and the captain|audio=GideonCaptainLongLiveTheEmpire.flac|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''captain''' served in a [[Galactic Empire]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. He [[Commanding officer|commanded]] an [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]], which was [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|attacked]] above the [[moon]] [[Trask]] in [[9 ABY]] by four [[Mandalorian]]s led by [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]. The [[captain]] sealed himself in the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] as [[stormtrooper]]s defended the hallways, who were then swiftly eliminated. He soon had the [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti'' assault carrier]] begin its ascent from Trask. After the Mandalorians took control of the cargo bay, the captain threatened to hunt them down if they stowed away with crates. He then contacted Gideon, requesting help from the moff. Gideon, though, ordered him to sacrifice himself and the Gozanti. Thus the captain [[Death|killed]] his officers in the bridge and began flying the assault [[carrier]] straight towards Trask. However, the Mandalorians stopped him and Kryze interrogated the man for the location of Gideon. The captain subsequently killed himself using a [[Electro capsule|suicide shocker]] in his [[mouth]]. ==Biography== ===Boarded above Trask=== {{Quote|How long until we clear the atmostphere and can make a jump to hyperspace?''"
"''We can't climb until we leave the harbor zone, sir.''"
"''Climb now.|The captain and the pilot|}} During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the [[captain]] served in a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. In [[9 ABY]], He [[Commanding officer|commanded]] an [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]] which went to the [[Water|estuary]] [[moon]] of [[Trask]] in the [[Kol Iben system]] to export weapons from a black market port, paid for with stolen resources from the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]]. The [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti'' Assault Carrier]] was attacked a number of times by a trio of [[Mandalorian]]s, [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], [[Koska Reeves]] and [[Axe Woves]], and the crew made sure to scan for life forms as a precaution before the assault [[carrier]]'s scheduled departure. The Gozanti set off at the start of the [[Standard day|day]], cruising along a shipping lane in preparation to ascend from Trask. However, Kryze, Reeves and Woves [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|attacked]] the assault carrier, accompanied by the Mandalorian [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]]. As the four Mandalorians fought the [[stormtrooper]]s on the outside walkways of the Gozanti, the captain made his way to the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], where the [[Starship|ship's]] [[Unidentified Imperial security officer (Trask)|security officer]] informed him of the situation. A stormtrooper from outside then dropped onto the bridge window, and the captain ordered that the hall to the bridge be guarded with the door sealed. [[File:Trask-officers.png|thumb|left|350px|The Imperial captain and his bridge officers in the Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier's cockpit.]] The Mandalorians made it inside the [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]] and began [[Death|eliminating]] more stormtroopers. The captain asked for an update, wishing to know the number of attackers. Although a stormtrooper reported at least ten attackers over comms, the [[security officer]] claimed that only four enemy life forms were present, and the stormtrooper identified the Mandalorians before being killed. The captain inquired on when the assault carrier would manage to leave into [[hyperspace]]. After the ship's [[Unidentified Imperial freighter pilot|pilot]] informed him that they were not allowed to ascend yet, the captain forcibly had the ''Gozanti'' assault carrier begin climbing altitude immediately. ===Sacrifice=== {{Quote|How far have they gotten?''"
"''They've breached the cargo hold and taken everything but the bridge. We require immediate backup.''"
"''If they've taken that much of the ship, I'm afraid that's no longer an option. You know what to do.|The captain and Gideon|}} The Mandalorians headed towards the cargo bay, where the ship's [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Trask)|deck officer]] was instructed by the captain to hold the infiltrators off until the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier entered hyperspace. The captain then listened over the comms as the [[deck officer]] had his stormtroopers trap the Mandalorians by closing the doors. The deck [[Imperial officer|officer]] informed the man that the enemies were trapped in the cargo control area. The captain realized that the Mandalorians could now use the cargo control area, but it was too late as the deck [[officer]] and his troops were flushed out of the assault carrier when the Mandalorians opened the cargo bay doors. The security officer reached out to the cargo bay, and Kryze responded, bragging about what the Mandalorians could do with the weapons they were seizing. The captain threatened to hunt the infiltrators down if they stole any crates, but his adversary stated her intention to take over the whole of the assault carrier. Thus the man contacted Gideon, informing the moff of the ongoing attack and requesting for backup. After the captain specified how much of the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier had been taken, Gideon implicitly ordered him to sacrifice the vessel. The captain complied with Gideon's order and shot the pilot and security officer with his [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]]. [[File:Imp_captain_suicide_pill.png|thumb|right|350px|The captain commits suicide after being interrogated by Bo-Katan Kryze.]] Taking the pilot controls, the captain forced the ''Gozanti'' assault carrier into a nose dive straight towards Trask's surface. The Mandalorians, though, reached the bridge, Djarin grabbing the man from his seat and taking the pilot controls with Reeves. As the two Mandalorians flew the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier back to level altitude, Kryze held the captain at knife point, demanding to know if Gideon had the [[Darksaber]], an ancient [[lightsaber]] used as a symbol of leadership in Mandalorian culture.{{Rebels|Trials of the Darksaber}} The man assured her she already knew, and Kryze promised to let him live if he led her to the moff. However, the captain claimed that Gideon would not let him live, and forcibly gnashed his teeth, activating a [[Electro capsule|suicide shocker]] that killed him. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I'll let you live. But you will take me to him.''"
"''You might let me live, but he won't.|Bo-Katan Kryze and the captain, on Gideon|}} [[File:Imp_captain_trask.png|thumb|left|350px|The Imperial captain was willing to sacrifice his ship and his people to stop the Mandalorian infiltrators.]] The captain was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with [[Color|light]] skin, grey [[hair]], and blue eyes. Upon learning that his ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier was being attacked, he had the bridge sealed and the hallways guarded to preserve his safety. When the Mandalorians continued to break through waves of stormtroopers, the captain frequently asked for updates from his officers and rushed the assault carrier into beginning its ascent early. The man advised the deck officer and his troops to buy time for the ''Gozanti'' assault carrier to escape, and took a moment to realize when the deck officer had accidentally given the Mandalorians control of the cargo bay doors. After hearing the officer and his troopers get flushed out from the assault carrier, the captain nervously swallowed. When Bo-Katan Kryze took control of the cargo bay, the captain claimed that he would hunt the Mandalorian and her accomplices if they stole from the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier. With the infiltrators having taken a large portion of the assault carrier, the captain reached out to Gideon for help. Having then been ordered by the moff to sacrifice himself and the ''Gozanti'' assault carrier, the man complied and killed his two officers in the bridge to take the pilot controls. In response to Bo-Katan Kryze's promise to let him live if he led her to Gideon, the captain, knowing that Gideon would kill him regardless, committed suicide. ==Equipment== {{Quote|If you think you're going to escape with those weapons you are sadly mistaken. Even if you manage to jettison a few of those crates, we will comb the entire area until you are hunted down and killed.|The captain, to Bo-Katan Kryze|}} [[File:CaptainKillsBridgeCrew-TMCh11.png|thumb|right|350px|The captain used his SE-14r light repeating blaster to kill his own bridge crew.]] The captain [[Clothing|wore]] the standard [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial naval command officer, including an [[Imperial kepi]] and a [[code cylinder]] attached below each shoulder. He wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his left [[breast]] with three red bars above three blue. The captain used an SE-14r light repeating [[blaster]] to shoot his two officers in the bridge and eventually committed suicide using an electric shock mechanism in his mouth that he could activate by forcibly gnashing his teeth. ==Behind the scenes== The captain appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]] and released on [[November 13]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}} Credited as "captain," he was played by [[Titus Welliver]] with [[Con Schell]] serving as the stunt double. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified Imperial captain}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 2|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 2]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 3|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 3]] ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/mando-download-chapter-11-the-heiress|text=Mando Download: "Chapter 11: The Heiress"}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-11-the-heiress-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' -
